description: Single storey rear extension, rear dormer with Juliette balcony and replacement of windows to property.
decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location PlanExisting Block Plan 2510 03 005Proposed Block Plan 2510 03 125 AExisting GF Plan 2510 03 010Existing FF Plan 2510 03 011Existing SF Plan 2510 03 012Existing Roof Plan 2510 03 013Existing Section AA 2510 03 020Existing North-West Elevation 2510 03 030Existing South-East Elevation 2510 03 031Existing North-East Elevation 2510 03 032Proposed GF Plan 2510 03 130Proposed FF Plan 2510 03 131Proposed SF Plan 2510 03 132Proposed Roof Plan 2510 03 133Proposed Section AA 2510 03 200Proposed North-West Elevation 2510 03 300Proposed South-East Elevation 2510 03 301Proposed North-East Elevation 2510 03 302Design & Access StatementCasement SystemReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials to match those in the existing building or as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.
